turns.answer:
For a 3-in-1 MagSafe charging station that keeps your iPhone cool, I'd prioritize active cooling (a built-in fan) over just charging speed.

Wireless charging generates heat, especially at 15–25W. A charger with a fan can help reduce temperature buildup, which is particularly useful if you charge while using StandBy mode or leave your phone on the charger overnight.

My preference would be a Qi2-certified charging station with active cooling, capable of charging an iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods simultaneously.
